body_markdown:
*Club Wingstop members get exclusive access to earn a free Watch Party Bundle and Ticketmaster® Ticket Cash® code, while supplies last*


DALLAS


, Sept. 22, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Game day starts with Wingstop. Following incredible demand for its limited-availability Wing Pass, Wingstop (NASDAQ: WING) is keeping the wins coming for all Club Wingstop members with the new Game Day Punch Card*, an exclusive rewards offer built for football season. Not a member? Join Club Wingstop.


Available from Sept. 24 through Oct. 21, Club Wingstop members can access the Game Day Punch Card directly through their account, with each membership eligible to complete the Punch Card and claim the reward once. Guests who purchase three Watch Party Bundles can earn a fourth Watch Party Bundle free**, along with a $50 Ticketmaster® Ticket Cash® code***, while supplies last. Fans can rack up all three qualifying purchases in one day or throughout the promotional period – just place each Watch Party Bundle as a separate order.


Built for feeding game day crowds, the Wingstop Watch Party Bundle includes 20 classic wings sauced and tossed in up to four signature flavors, a large order of seasoned fries and a large side of Wingstop’s iconic housemade ranch.


To take advantage of the Game Day Punch Card and unlock exclusive seasonal perks, fans can join Club Wingstop for free on Wingstop.com or through the official Wingstop mobile app.


* *See full Game Day Punch Card Terms and Conditions at*[Wingstop.com/Offers](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4779583-1&h=3326785696&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wingstop.com%2Foffers&a=Wingstop.com%2FOffers) *.*


***Delivery fees apply. Minimum $5.00 purchase required for delivery.*


****Ticketmaster and Ticketmaster Ticket Cash are registered trademarks of Live Nation Entertainment, Inc.*


**About Wingstop** Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Dallas, TX, Wingstop Inc. (NASDAQ: WING) operates and franchises more than 3,000 restaurants worldwide, with approximately 98% of the total restaurant count owned by brand partners. Generating over $5 billion in system-wide sales in fiscal 2025, Wingstop offers made-to-order, always fresh classic and boneless wings, tenders and chicken sandwiches in 12 bold, distinctive flavors, alongside signature sides and iconic housemade ranch and bleu cheese dips. Dedicated to Serving the World Flavor, Wingstop is the Official Chicken Partner of the NBA with a vision to become a Top 10 Global Restaurant Brand. Learn more at wingstop.com or follow @Wingstop on X, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.
